title: Mac and Cheese
ingredients: 1/2 cup butter (salted or unsalted), divided into 1/4 cups
instructions: Cook pasta as per box instructions, drain and place evenly across the bottom of the aluminum tray.
Melt 1/4 cup butter over medium-low heat and add flour, whisking constantly to create a roux. Keep aside and let it cool
In the pasta pot, warm the milk - do not let it boil - and slowly add the cheese.
Stir until the cheese has melted and add the roux to the mixture.
Keep stirring until everything has combined and thickened.
Once the sauce has thickened, take off heat and pour into the tray containing the macaroni.
Mix to ensure all the macaroni has been evenly coated by the sauce.
Melt the remaining 1/4 cup butter in another sauce pan and add the bread crumbs to it. Mix to combine.
Pour this mixture on top of the macaroni and sauce.
Place the tray in the oven and bake for 30-35 minutes, until the top is golden-brown
Allow to cool for a few minutes before serving.
